'''Workshop on Numerical Ranges and Numerical Radii (WONRA)''' is a biennial workshop series on [[numerical range]]s and numerical radii which began in 1992.
==About==
Numerical ranges and numerical radii are useful in the study of matrix and operator theory.
These topics have applications in many subjects in pure and applied mathematics, such as
[[quadratic forms]], [[Banach spaces]], [[dilation theory]], [[control theory]], [[numerical analysis]], [[quantum information science]].<ref>{{cite book|last1=Bhatia|first1=R.|title=Matrix Analysis|date=1997|publisher=Springer-Verlag|isbn=978-0387948461|pages=349|url=https://www.springer.com/us/book/9780387948461}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Bonsall|first1=F.|last2=Duncan|first2=J.|title=Numerical Ranges of Operators on Normed Spaces and of Elements of Normed Algebras|date=1971|publisher= Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0521079884|pages=148}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Bonsall|first1=F.|last2=Duncan|first2=J.|title=Numerical Ranges II, Vol. 2|date=1973|publisher= Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0521202275|pages=179}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Gustafson |first1=K.E.|author1-link=Karl Edwin Gustafson|last2=Rao|first2=D.K.M.|title=Numerical Range: The Field of Values of Linear Operators and Matrices|date=1997|publisher=Springer-Verlag|isbn=978-0387948355|pages=190|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9780387948355}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Istratescu|first1=B.|title=Introduction to Linear Operator Theory|date=1982|publisher=Marcel Dekker|isbn= 978-0824768966|pages=608}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Halmos |first1=P.R.|title=A Hilbert Space Problem Book|volume=19|date=1982|publisher=Springer-Verlag|isbn=978-0387906850|pages=373|doi=10.1007/978-1-4615-9976-0|series=Graduate Texts in Mathematics}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite book|last1=Horn|first1=R.A.|last2=Johnson|first2=C.R.|title=Topics in Matrix Analysis|url=https://archive.org/details/topicsinmatrixan0000horn|url-access=registration|date=1991|publisher= Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0521467131|pages=[https://archive.org/details/topicsinmatrixan0000horn/page/616 616]}}</ref>
==History==
In the early 1970s, numerical range workshops were organized by [[Frank Bonsall]] and John Duncan. More activities were started in early 1990s, including the biennial workshop series, which began in 1992,
and special issues devoted to this workshop were published.<ref>{{cite journal|editor-last1=Ando|editor-first1=T.|editor-last2=Li|editor-first2=C.K.|title=Special issue devoted to WONRA|journal=Linear and Multilinear Algebra|date=1994|volume=37|issue=1–3}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite journal|editor-last1=Ando|editor-first1=T.|editor-last2=Li|editor-first2=C.K.|title=Special issue devoted to WONRA|journal=Linear and Multilinear Algebra|date=1998|volume=43|issue=4}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite journal|editor-last1=Li|editor-first1=C.K.|editor-last2=Tam|editor-first2=T.Y.|title=Special issue devoted to WONRA|journal=Linear and Multilinear Algebra|date=2006|volume=52|issue=3–4}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite journal|editor-last1=Li|editor-first1=C.K.|editor-last2=Tam|editor-first2=T.Y.|title=Special issue devoted to WONRA|journal=Linear and Multilinear Algebra|date=2009|volume=57|issue=5}}</ref>
